questions.prompt: Which conference in 1919 produced the post-war settlement of Europe?
questions.fact: An economist attending resigned in protest and wrote a book predicting the settlement would cause another war.

questions.prompt: Which physical quantity is measured in pascals?
questions.fact: Atmospheric pressure at sea level is about 101,000 of them, which is roughly a kilogram pressing on every square centimetre of you.

questions.prompt: Which stadium is known as the Theatre of Dreams?
questions.fact: The nickname came from a former player turned commentator, and the club adopted it in its own marketing.

questions.prompt: Which film features a character named Neo?
questions.fact: Its bullet-time effect used over a hundred still cameras fired in sequence rather than a moving camera.

questions.prompt: Which US state has the most national parks?
questions.fact: It has nine, spanning desert, alpine and coastal terrain within a single state.

questions.prompt: Who wrote the novel The Road's earlier work, Blood Meridian?
questions.fact: It draws closely on documented events of the 1840s southwest, which is much of what makes it so bleak.

questions.prompt: What does the acronym CMS stand for in web publishing?
questions.fact: WordPress alone powers a substantial share of all websites, which makes its security everyone's problem.
